policy: Every notation, macro or syntax extension declared in a reusable-, source- or internal-tier module is listed here with its owning module, canonical command text, precedence and scope. The static checker fails when the tree declares one that is not listed, or lists one that no longer exists; the probe checker proves each `local` row is not visible to an importer.
